abstract: Pregnancy with choriocarcinoma is a rare tumor. It is rare for neonates to survive the third trimester. This article reports the clinical data of a live fetal pregnancy with choriocarcinoma complicated by brain and lung metastases. The patient was admitted to the hospital for "menopause 28 weeks + 5 days, dizziness with nausea and vomiting 2 days." After 5 hours of admission, the patient had sudden convulsions, urinary incontinence, and coma. A head computed tomography (CT) examination in the emergency department revealed a cerebral hemorrhage in the right occipital lobe and broke into the ventricular system with brain herniation. She was immediately transferred to the intensive care unit for the emergency cesarean section and intracerebral hematoma removal. A postoperative CT scan revealed that the tumor in the upper lobe of the right lung was considered lung cancer, with multiple metastases in both lungs. Postoperative pathology was metastatic choriocarcinoma tissue seen in the blood clot. Based on the pathological diagnosis of choriocarcinoma, a chemotherapy regimen was developed with 2 courses of EP regimen and 8 courses of combined EMA-CO chemotherapy regimen. The patients were followed up for 2 years and ultimately resolved.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌を合併した妊娠は稀な腫瘍である。妊娠third trimesterまで新生児が生存することは稀である。本稿では、脳転移および肺転移を合併した、生児を有する絨毛癌合併妊娠の臨床経過を報告する。患者は「閉経28週+5日、2日間のめまい、悪心・嘔吐」を主訴に入院した。入院5時間後、患者は突然の痙攣、尿失禁、昏睡を生じた。救急部での頭部CT検査で、右後頭葉の脳出血を認め、脳室系へ破綻し脳ヘルニアを伴っていた。緊急帝王切開および脳内血腫除去術のため、直ちに集中治療室へ搬送された。術後のCTでは、右肺上葉の腫瘍は肺癌と考えられ、両肺に多発転移を認めた。術後病理では、血腫内に転移性絨毛癌組織が認められた。絨毛癌の病理診断に基づき、EP療法2コースと、EMA-CO併用化学療法8コースからなる化学療法レジメンを立案した。患者は2年間経過観察され、最終的に寛解した。
